verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a tax-compliance API/SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant runtime that itself consumes external tools. The evidence shows the reverse relationship — Kintsugi publishes its own MCP server so external AI assistants (e.g., coding copilots) can query its docs — but there is no indication Kintsugi itself acts as an MCP client plugging in outside MCP servers to gain new tool capabilities, so this client-role story is a category mismatch for this kind of product.
